local-3-node.topology: one localhost gateway plus two localhost peers
notes: Publisher and subscriber WebSocket clients both attach to the publisher peer.
The three-node mesh is still formed and the contract is retained there; notify uses the local executor channel to avoid locator min-merge drops under cross-node reordering.
Freenet 0.2.112 UPDATE requires ContractKey.code to carry WASM bytes (stdlib double-hash bug).
Cross-node notify remains available via FREENET_FORCE_CROSS_NODE=1 but is not gate evidence yet.

live.remaining: requires explicit authorization before any live-network contract update

viability.summary: Local p95 update-to-notify is under 90 ms for 1 KiB and 64 KiB and under 260 ms for 1 MiB. That is fast enough for every transport role on the measured path. Live-network confirmation and an honest cross-node notify series remain open.
